narrative.overview: A Lalbagh-style glasshouse on a calm mint ground; each finished step leaves a flower in its pane.
keyCharacteristics: Mint ground, glass surfaces, leaf ink
One arch, same size on every screen
Bloom red for flowers and one word

rules.name: The One Bloom Rule
rules.body: Red is for flowers and at most one large word per screen.

dos: Keep the arch in the same place on every screen.
Show progress as panes, never a progress bar.
donts: No photos, cards, shadows or gradients as chrome.
No bloom red on small text, buttons or errors.
